subject: Regional readiness matrix and evidence gaps
messages:
From: Susan Keller <susan.keller@meritech.com>
To: avery.johnson@redwood.ai
Cc: procurement@meritech.com
Date: 2026-11-23T08:12:00-05:00
Subject: Regional readiness matrix and evidence gaps

Hi Avery,

Thanks for the quick intro last week. MeriTech is doing a cross-regional compliance intake ahead of a larger procurement review. We need a concise "regional readiness matrix" that calls out: ISO 27001 scope and controls, EU data residency specifics, and a FedRAMP-equivalent baseline we can use for our US operations.

Specifically we need:
- A short mapping (controls -> evidence artifacts) for ISO 27001 and FedRAMP gaps in the EU region.
- Sampling profile for evidence (how many days of logs, snapshot windows, how you sample config drift).
- Clarification on KMS/HSM ownership boundary (customer-managed keys vs Redwood-managed).
- Any operational constraints for on-prem/private deployments that change evidence collection.

Can you share a matrix + sample artifacts and a suggested timeline? Our procurement team would like to see a 2-week intake window and sample artifacts for SOC 2 logs and CAIQ responses. I attached the RFP excerpt that lists what they expect.

Attachment: MeriTech_RFP_Q1.pdf (pdf)

Appreciate a short plan and who will own each ask.

Best,
Susan
Director, Vendor Risk Management
MeriTech Bank

3) By EOD +7 business days: sample artifacts and a drive folder with SOC 2 log samples, CAIQ draft answers, and the sampling profile.

Kimberly will lead evidence extraction and is cc'd. Tessa will own sampling profiles and the audit-window notes. If there are particular controls you want prioritized for sampling (e.g., access logging, key management, encryption at rest), please flag them and we will sequence accordingly.

I attached the matrix template to speed the mapping. Also linking a shared folder where we'll drop artifacts: https://drive.redwood.ai/drive/folders/meritech-readiness

From: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>
To: Avery Johnson <avery.johnson@redwood.ai>, Susan Keller <susan.keller@meritech.com>
Cc: tessa_morgan@redwood.ai, priyom_das@redwood.ai
Date: 2026-11-23T11:22:00-05:00
Subject: Re: Regional readiness matrix and evidence gaps — mapping notes

Morning all — quick mapping and a few clarifying questions.

What we'll provide in the drive folder this week (deliverable list):
- control_matrix_eu_us.csv (control id, description, evidence artifact name, owner, retention window)
- evidence_sampling_profiles.xlsx (example sampling profiles: daily log slice, 7-day snapshot, monthly config snapshot)
- two redacted SOC 2 artifacts (access log excerpt, change-control ticket sample)

Notes / constraints for MeriTech to be aware of:
- Log extraction window: default snapshots are 7 days of high-fidelity logs and a 30-day takeaway for on-demand review. For FedRAMP-like requests we can extend to 90-day forensic slices but need lead time and storage permissions.
- KMS boundary: Redwood supports both RM-managed and customer KMS. For customer-managed keys (bring-your-own KMS), we will need the key access logs and a brief KMS attestation from your side; that changes our evidence package and the sampling approach.
- On-prem/private deployments: if you plan to run an enclave in a MeriTech datacenter, evidence collection will require an agent-assisted snapshot (we'll coordinate with your infra team) and the lead time is typically +10 business days for scheduling.

Question for MeriTech: which controls are highest priority for a SOC 2 sample? Our default pick is: 1) logical access logging (login events + MFA enforcement), 2) change control for production config, 3) vulnerability scan reports for the last 30 days. If you prefer different controls, please advise.

Attaching the sampling workbook for visibility.

Attachment: evidence_sampling_profiles.xlsx (xlsx)

Kimberly Park
Security Program Manager, Redwood Inference
kimberly_park@redwood.ai
